title: Lawn Care Service Call Intake Form
subtitle: Control mowing, cultivation, irrigation review, treatment, and property handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete lawn care service call intake for turf zones, plantings, irrigation features, and service equipment. It connects service plan, product label, site map, and instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a lawn-service coordinator must triage and route a new lawn care request without promising scope before site, asset, hazard, access, and authorization facts are known.

sections.title: Lawn Care reported condition and immediate triage
sections.guidance: Preserve the caller's facts, distinguish an active hazard from a service symptom, and assign immediate controls.

blocks.label: Reported condition, symptom, or service trigger
items: Turf density, height, color, vigor, and bare areas
Weed, insect, disease, animal, and other pest evidence
Soil moisture, compaction, erosion, grade, and drainage
Irrigation coverage, leaks, heads, runoff, and schedule
Trees, shrubs, beds, edging, roots, and mulch condition
Mowing pattern, scalping, clipping, thatch, and previous service effects
Obstacles, debris, utilities, hardscape, vehicles, and fragile property
Slope, ground firmness, access width, gate, and traffic conditions
Weather, wind, heat, rainfall, and treatment suitability
Sensitive plants, water, pollinator habitat, and neighboring exposure
blocks.guidance: Select only observations reported or directly confirmed during intake.

blocks.label: Condition timing, recurrence, and current state

items: Property and treatment boundaries confirmed before work

Mower guards, discharge controls, blades, and service equipment inspected
Product label, applicator qualification, PPE, and application conditions verified
Water, wells, storm drains, pollinator areas, and neighboring property protected
Mowing height, route, clipping, pruning, and treatment instructions defined
Gate, key, alarm, and access controls preserved
Reentry, watering, cleanup, and follow-up instructions assigned

sections.title: Lawn Care dispatch decision and technician preparation
sections.guidance: Translate intake facts into an explicit assignment without implying that unverified work or price is authorized.

blocks.label: Dispatch and qualification assignment
Likely diagnostic or service preparation
items: Mow to the approved height and pattern
Edge approved hardscape and bed boundaries
Trim around obstacles without property damage
Collect or distribute clippings as authorized
Aerate, dethatch, seed, or topdress approved zones
Apply label-consistent fertilizer or control product
Adjust or report irrigation condition
Remove approved debris and restore gates
Photograph material property or plant condition
Communicate watering, reentry, and next-service instructions
blocks.guidance: This is a preparation list, not authorization to complete every listed task.

blocks.guidance: Verify the full intake record before arrival and stop or escalate when weather, chemical labeling, people or pets, hidden utilities, slope, equipment guarding, property boundary, or treatment condition is uncertain.

sections.title: Lawn Care intake exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, immediate protection, decision owner, deadline, and dispatch restriction reconstructable.

blocks.label: Lawn Care exception and stop-work indicators
items: People, pets, traffic, or property remain in the discharge or work zone
Hidden utility, irrigation, wire, drain, or obstacle location uncertain
Slope, wet ground, drop-off, heat, storm, or lightning condition unsafe
Equipment guard, blade, tire, control, or emergency stop is defective
Product label, qualification, PPE, weather, or application boundary not met
Spray drift, runoff, overspread, spill, or non-target plant exposure
Tree, branch, retaining wall, sinkhole, or structural condition appears unstable
Property line, customer instruction, or protected zone is disputed
Plant damage, disease, or condition exceeds authorized lawn-care scope
Work would conflict with irrigation, construction, occupants, or another vendor
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

blocks.label: Exception containment, decision, and escalation register
Controlled hold or exception status

sections.title: Lawn Care service call intake closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register

blocks.guidance: Use this lawn care service call intake with the applicable customer agreement, manufacturer information, product instructions, site policy, licensing, safety, privacy, and retention requirements. It records the stated decision but does not create authority, coverage, compliance, or release when identity, evidence, scope, condition, or acceptance remains unresolved.
